title: Cpg Supply Chain Manager
description:
CPG Supply Chain Manager

Location: Remote (LATAM based)

Employment Type: Full time

Salary: $35K USD


About the Role

We are looking for a dedicated, full time Supply Chain Manager to own demand planning, vendor management, and wholesale replenishment across our portfolio of consumer products brands. This is a company with multiple direct to consumer subscription brands, one single purchase DTC brand, and two wholesale brands sold through major retail partners.


This role sits at the center of our supply chain operations, working closely with our warehouse team, finance, and brand leads to keep inventory accurate, purchase orders on schedule, and reporting visible to leadership. You will be the person who catches a forecasting error before it becomes a stockout, who flags an FBA shipment deadline before it slips, and who builds the reporting infrastructure that lets leadership see inventory health at a glance across every brand and channel.


This is a dedicated, single client role. You will not be splitting your time or attention across other companies or accounts.


Key Responsibilities

Sales Order and Inventory Accuracy Across Channels

  • Own the process of pulling sales orders across all sales channels, including wholesale retail partners and marketplace channels, and ensuring inventory is accurately and promptly decremented as orders ship from our warehouse
  • Maintain a real time, accurate view of true available inventory at all times, since forecasting, reordering, and fulfillment decisions all depend on this number being correct
  • Review and reconcile weekly cycle count data provided by the warehouse shipping and receiving coordinator against expected inventory levels based on sales order activity
  • Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies, tracing issues back to root cause, whether that is a sales order processing error, a receiving error, or a physical count error
  • Note: this role reviews and reconciles cycle count data but does not have supervisory authority over the warehouse coordinator, who reports separately to the Senior Operations Manager

Demand Planning and Forecasting

  • Analyze sales velocity across all DTC brands and forecast demand by SKU
  • Determine and execute reorder timing and quantities for DTC brands to avoid stockouts and overstock
  • Incorporate seasonality trends and channel performance data from ecommerce, Amazon, retail marketplace, and social commerce channels into forecasting and reorder decisions

Vendor, Production, and Purchase Order Management

  • Create, track, and reconcile purchase orders, flagging issues before they affect operations
  • Track supplier lead times and follow up on delayed shipments
  • Coordinate directly with our overseas production team on reorder needs, production timing, and inventory availability
  • Maintain steady vendor relationships and communication, particularly when timelines get tight

Marketplace Fulfillment Management

  • Own the shipment calendar and deadline tracking for inventory sent into third party fulfillment centers (including Amazon FBA), ensuring shipments are submitted on time to prevent sales disruption
  • Proactively flag potential shortages or overstock situations before they affect sales

Wholesale Replenishment

  • Track replenishment needs and inventory levels for our wholesale retail partners
  • Coordinate with wholesale retailer portals and contacts on stock levels, reorder timing, and order minimums
  • Ensure wholesale order planning accounts for retailer specific lead times and minimum order requirements

Documentation and Reporting

  • Maintain organized, accessible documentation for vendor contracts and communications
  • Maintain a formal reorder tracker and replenishment schedule, kept current and accessible to leadership
  • Build and maintain regular reporting on inventory health, discrepancy trends, and stock levels across all brands, giving leadership clear and reliable visibility
  • Proactively communicate inventory risks and planning recommendations directly to leadership, rather than waiting to be asked
  • Support cross functional projects tied to supply chain systems or reporting improvements


What We Are Looking For

title: Domain Expert- Science & Technology
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

  • We are seeking a highly qualified Science & Technology Domain Expert to evaluate and improve Large Language Models (LLMs). You will design challenging prompts, assess factual accuracy and reasoning, and identify knowledge gaps within physics, chemistry, biology, engineering, AI, computer science, emerging technologies.


Key Responsibilities

  • Create advanced prompts covering physics, chemistry, biology, engineering, AI, computer science, emerging technologies.
  • Evaluate AI-generated responses for factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and nuance.
  • Identify hallucinations, logical inconsistencies, outdated information, and edge cases.
  • Develop benchmark datasets and adversarial test cases.
  • Provide evidence-based feedback with reliable references.
  • Collaborate with AI researchers to improve model performance.
  • Maintain high annotation quality and documentation.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's degree or higher in any field;
    degrees in Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or other science and technology-related disciplines are preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of science and technology, including physics, chemistry, biology, engineering principles, artificial intelligence, computer science, emerging technologies, scientific research, and recent technological advancements.
  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in scientific research, engineering, technology, software development, academia, technical writing, science journalism, data science, AI, or a related field.
  • Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to evaluate science and technology-related information accurately, identify factual inconsistencies, and assess reasoning across a broad range of scientific and technical topics.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with LLMs, Generative AI, prompt engineering, or AI evaluation.
  • Published research, industry recognition, or teaching experience is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently and provide objective, evidence-backed reviews.


Offer Details:

Application Process

title: Founding Bdr - Business Development Representative
description:
Location: Remote — Latin America

Employment Type: Full-time, Contractor


About the Role

We're looking for our Founding BDR — someone who wants to build the outbound engine from the ground up and grow into a full sales career as our team scales. This isn't a "make 100 dials and disappear" job. You'll own top-of-funnel pipeline generation, working closely with our Account Executives to book qualified meetings that turn into closed revenue. As the first BDR on the team, you'll help define what "great outbound" looks like here: messaging, sequences, ICP refinement, and process — not just execute someone else's playbook.


What you’ll do

  • Prospect and identify companies/contacts that match our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP)
  • Run outbound sequences across email, LinkedIn, videos and cold calling to generate interest
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads against ICP criteria before booking
  • Schedule qualified meetings for the Account Executive team
  • Keep CRM data clean and up to date (activity, notes, lead status)
  • Partner with AEs and sales leadership to refine targeting, messaging, and outreach cadence
  • Hit and exceed monthly meeting-generation targets

What we are looking for

  • Prior experience in outbound prospecting, SDR/BDR, or sales development (B2B preferred)
  • You’re not afraid of picking up the phone and dialing.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills Comfortable with high-volume outreach and rejection — persistence without burning out: a few “nos” a day will not scare you.
  • Organized, self-motivated, and coachable;
    comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-moving environment
  • Familiarity with CRM and sales engagement tools (HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo, etc.) is a plus
  • Genuine interest in growing into a closing (AE) role plus)

Why join us

  • Ground-floor opportunity to shape the outbound function, not just execute a script Direct mentorship path into a closing role
  • Direct path to an Account Executive role
  • Fully remote, flexible LatAm-based team


This is a Founding BDR role by design: it comes with a clear, defined path to promotion into an Account Executive position once you've demonstrated consistent quality pipeline generation and sales fundamentals. You'll be mentored directly by the AE team and sales leadership as part of that transition — this role is meant to be a launchpad, not a ceiling.

Com uma trajetória com mais de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A . está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.


Nossas +1400 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 70 milhões de clientes em todo o país.


A área de Inteligência Comercial utiliza dados, análises avançadas e modelos preditivos para apoiar decisões relacionadas a precificação, promoções, sortimento e exposição de produtos. Seu objetivo é identificar oportunidades de crescimento e gerar insights que contribuam para o aumento da receita, da margem e da eficiência comercial, apoiando a tomada de decisão estratégica do negócio.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:


  • Desenvolver modelos analíticos e preditivos para apoiar decisões relacionadas a pricing, sortimento, modulação, promoções e exposição de produtos;
  • Identificar oportunidades de crescimento por meio da análise da performance dos produtos, categorias, canais e regiões;
  • Aplicar técnicas de machine learning, estatística e segmentação para otimizar decisões comerciais e aumentar receita, margem e conversão;
  • Construir estudos de potencial de venda, canibalização, substituição de produtos, elasticidade e impacto de alavancas comerciais;
  • Desenvolver frameworks de recomendação para apoio à definição de mix, modulação, priorização de sortimento e exposição de produtos;
  • Traduzir dados complexos em insights acionáveis para lideranças e áreas de negócio, influenciando decisões estratégicas;
  • Estruturar métricas, indicadores e metodologias que permitam monitorar resultados e capturar oportunidades de melhoria contínua;
  • Garantir a evolução dos modelos analíticos em produção, acompanhando performance, estabilidade e geração de valor para o negócio.


Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:


  • Experiência sólida em Ciência de Dados aplicada a problemas de negócio;
  • Conhecimento avançado em estatística, modelagem preditiva e machine learning;
  • Domínio de Python para análise, manipulação de dados e desenvolvimento de modelos analíticos;
  • Domínio de SQL para extração, transformação e exploração de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Experiência na construção e interpretação de testes, experimentos e análises de impacto;
  • Conhecimento emtécnicas de clusterização, segmentação, previsão e otimização;
  • Experiência comferramentas de visualização de dados e construção de dashboards executivos;
  • Capacidade de traduzir análises complexas em recomendações claras para áreas de negócio;
  • Conhecimento deproblemas típicos de varejo, como precificação, promoções, sortimento, abastecimento, ruptura e comportamento de compra;
  • Familiaridade com Inteligência Artificial e técnicas modernas de Analytics aplicadas ao varejo.



Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:


  • Técnicas de recomendação de produtos, otimização de sortimento e planejamento comercial;
  • Ambientes cloude plataformas de dados como Databricks, BigQuery, Azure ou equivalentes;
  • Modelos de elasticidade de preço, demanda e previsão de vendas;
  • Boas práticas de MLOps, incluindo versionamento, automação, monitoramento e implantação de modelos;
  • Métodos causais(uplift modeling, causal inference, experimentação e testes A/B);
  • Operação de varejo omnichannel e indicadores de performance comercial.



OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.


Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios:


Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco;
  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.


Quem Somos:

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.400 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!



Nosso Jeito:

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.



Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é amar resolver a vida das pessoas , de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma;
priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias;
valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .


Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

title: Analista De Vendas Internas Jr
description:
Nós Elevamos... Qualidade de vida urbana


Os nossos elevadores, escadas e esteiras rolantes transportam com segurança mais de dois bilhões de pessoas em edifícios e centros de transporte todos os dias. Como parte da equipe Schindler, você descobrirá um trabalho significativo que melhora a qualidade de vida das comunidades e contribui para tornar os locais mais acessíveis, inclusivos e sustentáveis para todos. Ao se juntar a nós, você não apenas se torna parte de nossa história de sucesso, você ajuda a moldar o futuro e continua nosso rico legado que começou lá em 1874.


No Brasil somos a Atlas Schindler, estamos no país desde 1918, com mais de 100 anos de história. Fabricamos, instalamos, modernizamos e prestamos o melhor serviço de manutenção para elevadores, escadas e esteiras rolantes. Somos líderes do segmento de mobilidade urbana no Brasil, e procuramos para trabalhar com a gente pessoas alinhadas aos nossos valores, que promovam um ótimo ambiente de trabalho para colegas e realizem um serviço excepcional aos clientes.

  • Monitorar resultados e elaborar relatórios de acompanhamento, identificando oportunidades de melhoria nos processos e na performance comercial.
  • Atuar em parceria com equipes internas e áreas de apoio para garantir a eficiência das operações e a satisfação dos clientes.
  • Contribuir para a padronização, melhoria contínua e inovação dos processos comerciais e operacionais, seguindo as diretrizes e procedimentos corporativos.
  • Promover a excelência no atendimento, fortalecendo o relacionamento com clientes e contribuindo para o crescimento sustentável do negócio.


Quais os Requisitos?

Ensino superior cursando ou completo em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas.

Facilidade com tecnologia e sistemas (CRM será um diferencial);

Experiência prévia com atendimento ao cliente ou área comercial será considerada um diferencial.


O que você ganha com isso?

  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;

  • Vale Refeição (com possibilidade de desmembramento parcial para Vale Alimentação) ou Restaurante no local – de acordo com a localidade de atuação;

  • Parceria de descontos com universidades e outras instituições de ensino.

Nós Elevamos... Sua carreira


Faça parte da nossa equipe e nos ajude a melhorar a qualidade de vida e a impulsionar a inovação, elevando o nível de segurança e sustentabilidade. Valorizamos suas diversas habilidades e perspectivas, pois juntos moldamos as cidades sustentáveis de hoje e de amanhã.

title: Consultor De Investimentos - Wealth
description:
Sobre a Altside

A Altside é a 1ª consultoria de investimentos do Brasil focada em criptomoedas. Acreditamos que liberdade e soberania sobre o próprio patrimônio só existem de verdade quando viram tempo;
tempo para estar com a família, para se aposentar mais cedo, para viver a vida que o dinheiro deveria liberar, não prender. Por isso, ajudamos pessoas e famílias a acelerarem a construção de patrimônio, unindo o melhor do mercado tradicional e cripto em estratégias personalizadas de investimento.


Pra quem é essa vaga

Aqui você não espera "o tempo de casa" para assumir responsabilidade de verdade;
quem entrega bem, ganhaespaço rápido. Se você busca um ambiente onde pode propor, errar, ajustar e crescer, vai se sentir em casa. É também um lugar para quem quer aprender rápido: você vai estar perto de quem decide, com acesso direto para entender o porquê das coisas — não só o que fazer.


O que você vai encontrar aqui

  • Você vai ter autonomia com responsabilidade;
  • Vai estar pertode pessoas e líderes excelentes: horizontalidade não é discurso, é realidade;
  • E vai atuar numlugar que trata honestidade, com cliente e entre as pessoas, como o não-negociável mais intrínseco.


Quem nós buscamos

Uma pessoa com histórico sólido em relacionamento com investidores e paixão real pelo mercado cripto.


Alguém com bagagem para lidar com clientes exigentes, capacidade consultiva para gerar valor estratégico a partir do relacionamento e visão para conduzir o cliente a novos níveis de independência financeira, usando o mercado cripto como ferramenta.


Esperamos um perfil maduro, analítico e empático, que saiba equilibrar performance e propósito, e que se identifique com a missão da Altside de promover liberdade e soberania financeira.


Você será responsável por

  • Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento, construção de carteiras e planejamento financeiro e sucessório com clientes da base;
  • Aprofundar e fortalecer o relacionamento com investidores, identificando oportunidades para novos aportes e migração de capital do mercado tradicional para cripto;
  • Acompanhar a jornada do cliente em todas as 4 etapas da metodologia Altside: Construção, Otimização, Planejamento e Sucessão;
  • Ser o ponto de contato estratégico dos clientes, garantindo clareza, proximidade e confiança em cada interação;
  • Participar da avaliação e refinamento de processos junto ao time de Produto, garantindo coerência com a jornada real do cliente;
  • Colaborar com as áreas de Research, Marketing, Comercial e Produto para garantir que a experiência do cliente seja sempre personalizada e de alto valor;
  • Apoiar o crescimento da operação com feedbacks, visão estratégica e construção de uma cultura centrada no cliente.


Quais as habilidades necessárias


Hardskills

  • Experiência sólida em relacionamento com investidores e gestão de clientes de alta renda (consultoria, assessoria, private etc.);
  • Domínio do mercado cripto, especialmente Bitcoin, DeFi e estratégias de alocação digital;
  • Habilidade paraconduzir conversas estratégicas e personalizadas com diferentes perfis de cliente;
  • Capacidade de leitura e análise de portfólios, relatórios e KPIs de desempenho.


Softskills

  • Comunicação clara, consultiva e com escuta ativa;
  • Capacidade de gerar confiança e orientar decisões com foco no resultado do cliente;
  • Visão estratégica e liderança colaborativa baseada em exemplo e entrega;
  • Organização e priorização de tarefas em múltiplas frentes;
  • Proatividade para identificar melhorias e agir com rapidez.


Detalhes importantes

  • Local de trabalho: Presencial (escritório em Florianópolis – bairro Saco Grande);
  • Remuneração: Fixo mensal + comissão mensal + bônus semestral;

description:

title: Domain Expert Reviewer- Science & Technology
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly qualified Science & Technology Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your expertise in science and technology will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across a broad range of scientific and technological topics.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review and validate domain-specific prompts covering physics, chemistry, biology, engineering, artificial intelligence, computer science, emerging technologies, and related fields.
  • Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, technical correctness, and compliance with project guidelines.
  • Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, and low-quality annotations.
  • Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives.
  • Provide clear, constructive, and evidence-based feedback to contributors to improve task quality.
  • Maintain consistency across reviews by following established quality standards and review guidelines.
  • Escalate ambiguous or technically complex cases when necessary and document review findings.
  • Collaborate with project managers and AI teams to continuously improve evaluation quality and review processes.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's degree or higher in any field;
    degrees in Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or other science and technology-related disciplines are preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of science and technology, including physics, chemistry, biology, engineering principles, artificial intelligence, computer science, emerging technologies, scientific research, and recent technological advancements.
  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in scientific research, engineering, technology, software development, academia, technical writing, science journalism, data science, AI, or a related field.
  • Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to evaluate science and technology-related information accurately, identify factual inconsistencies, and assess reasoning across a broad range of scientific and technical topics.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience reviewing AI-generated content, LLM evaluations, prompt engineering, or annotation quality.
  • Familiarity with quality assurance, editorial review, or technical content evaluation workflows.
  • Strong understanding of scientific principles, technological advancements, and emerging technologies.
  • Ability to provide objective, evidence-based feedback while maintaining consistent quality standards.
  • Experience working independently in a fast-paced, quality-focused environment.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.


Application Process

  • Complete the assessment shared with you.
  • Our team will evaluate your submission.
  • Selected candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps.

title: Senior Amazon Ppc Specialist
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a talented Amazon PPC Specialist to join our team and elevate our advertising efforts on Amazon’s platform. In this role, you will develop and manage PPC campaigns, perform in-depth keyword research, and continuously optimize ad performance to achieve and exceed KPI targets.

Responsibilities include analyzing campaign data, generating actionable reports, and utilizing tools like AdBadger, Helium 10 and Data Dive to drive campaign efficiency. You will also collaborate with marketing, sales, and product teams to ensure strategies align with business objectives and conduct competitor analysis to uncover new opportunities. If you are analytical, results-oriented, and passionate about Amazon advertising, we’d love to hear from you.


In this role, you will:

  • Implement & Develop PPC Campaigns: Design and execute Amazon PPC campaigns to enhance product visibility, drive traffic, and boost sales.
  • Conduct Keyword Research & Market Analysis: Perform keyword research, analyze market trends, and identify opportunities to optimize campaign performance
  • Monitor & Optimize PPC Campaign Performance: Continuously monitor PPC campaigns, adjust bids, and optimize ad placements to maximize ROI.
  • Conduct Keyword Research: Utilize tools such as Helium 10 and Data Dive to identify high-performing keywords relevant to the products. Analyze search volume, competition, and relevance to select optimal keywords that can drive traffic and conversions for PPC campaigns. Build and manage large keyword lists. Select keywords to use for PPC campaigns. Run PPC tests and analyze & report on results
  • Analytics & Reporting: Use analytics tools to track KPIs, generate reports, and provide actionable recommendations for campaign improvements.
  • Industry Trends & Compliance: Stay updated on Amazon’s advertising policies, algorithm changes, and best practices to maintain campaign compliance and effectiveness.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work with marketing, sales, and product teams to align PPC strategies with broader business goals.
  • Competitor Analysis: Conduct regular competitor analysis to identify competitive strengths, weaknesses, and new growth opportunities.


Essential Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (preferred).
  • Proven experience managing and optimizing Amazon PPC campaigns, with a record of achieving KPI targets.
  • In-depth understanding of Amazon ad types, including Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Displays, and DSP.
  • Expertise in keyword research, listing optimization, and competitor analysis to drive visibility and sales.
  • Adbadger considered an asset
  • Strong analytical skills and proficiency in data-driven decision-making to optimize PPC performance.
  • Skilled in using keyword research tools, bid management software, and analytics platforms.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced environment.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with advanced PPC management tools such as AdBadger or Data Dive.
  • 3+ Years Experience building and managing large keyword lists and conducting PPC tests.
  • Ability to analyze and report on campaign results, providing actionable insights for optimization.
  • Knowledge of Amazon’s advertising policies, algorithm changes, and best practices.
  • Experience conducting competitor analysis to identify strengths, weaknesses, and growth opportunities.


Salary Expectations (Depend on experience / Candidate)

  • $1,500-3,300 / month base (Includes bonus + incentives)

title: Financial Planning Manager
description:
Turn recurring reporting into a decision system.

Own management reporting, KPI dashboards, and forward-looking analysis for US leadership teams.

This is not a task-execution role. You will be expected to own outcomes, exercise judgment, improve how the work gets done, and communicate directly with senior stakeholders.


About MAVI

MAVI is an invite-only network connecting high-performing finance and accounting professionals with fast-growing US companies. Members are assessed for technical capability, communication, ownership, and leadership potential. Through MAVI, you work directly with finance leaders, own meaningful outcomes, and build a track record that can lead to increasingly senior opportunities.


What you'll own

  • Build and maintain executive, board, and investor reporting packages.
  • Develop KPI dashboards that connect operating metrics with financial outcomes.
  • Produce variance analysis and forward-looking commentary for monthly business reviews.
  • Partner with data, accounting, and functional teams to improve source-data quality.
  • Automate recurring reporting and reduce manual spreadsheet work.
  • Translate trends into concise actions, risks, and opportunities.


What makes you a fit

  • 6+ years in FP&A, financial analysis, business intelligence, or management reporting.
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets capability;
    Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar tools are valuable.
  • Experience building reporting for executives, boards, or investors.
  • Strong understanding of financial statements, KPIs, and variance analysis.
  • Able to distinguish meaningful signals from reporting noise.
  • Excellent written communication and comfort working with US stakeholders.


The seniority bar

  • You independently structure ambiguous business questions and turn them into decision-ready financial analysis.
  • You challenge assumptions constructively and can defend your recommendation with executives and non-finance leaders.
  • You build models and reporting frameworks that others can use—not one-off analyses that depend entirely on you.
  • You understand the business implication behind the numbers and communicate a clear point of view.


What success looks like

  • Leadership receives consistent, trusted reporting with less manual effort.
  • KPI and financial narratives clearly identify what changed and what to do next.
  • Data-quality issues are surfaced and resolved at the source.


Why join now

Deliver strongly in this scope and build toward FP&A Manager or Finance Business Partner opportunities across the MAVI network. Compensation is USD-denominated and aligned with experience, scope, and location. Working hours are designed around local schedules with reasonable, clearly defined overlap for US stakeholders.

description:

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

title: Mid-Level Accountant
description:

4ARC Consulting provides outsourced accounting, financial operations, and fractional CFO services to small and mid-sized businesses across multiple industries. We support clients with accurate financial reporting, streamlined accounting processes, and actionable financial insights.

We are growing our accounting team and looking for a Mid-Level Accountant who is detail-oriented, dependable, and comfortable supporting multiple U.S.-based clients.


Responsibilities

  • Perform day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping activities for multiple client accounts.
  • Categorize and review transactions and maintain accurate general ledger records.
  • Perform monthly bank and credit card reconciliations.
  • Prepare and post journal entries, accruals, prepaid expenses, and other month-end adjustments.
  • Support monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial close.
  • Review accounts payable and accounts receivable activity.
  • Record and reconcile payroll entries based on payroll reports.
  • Prepare and review Balance Sheets, Profit & Loss statements, and other financial reports.
  • Investigate account discrepancies and resolve reconciliation issues.
  • Maintain supporting schedules and accounting documentation.
  • Assist with accounting cleanups, catch-up projects, and system migrations.
  • Work with senior accounting and finance professionals to support client reporting and financial analysis.
  • Communicate professionally with the 4ARC team regarding open items, missing documentation, and accounting issues.
  • Support multiple clients while meeting established deadlines and maintaining confidentiality.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field.
  • 3–5+ years of accounting experience preferred.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, general ledger accounting, and month-end close.
  • Experience with bank reconciliations, journal entries, AP, AR, and financial statement preparation.
  • Experience with QuickBooks Online strongly preferred.
  • Experience with systems such as Sage Intacct, NetSuite, SAP, or similar ERP/accounting platforms is a plus.
  • Experience supporting U.S.-based companies or working with U.S. GAAP is a strong plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify accounting discrepancies independently.
  • Ability to manage multiple companies, clients, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Professional written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Comfortable working remotely and collaborating with a U.S.-based team.


What We're Looking For:

We are looking for someone who goes beyond basic data entry. The right candidate should understand how transactions flow through the financial statements, recognize when something does not look correct, investigate discrepancies, and take ownership of assigned accounting work.

You should be organized, proactive, comfortable asking questions when needed, and capable of working independently once processes and expectations are established.

title: Domain Expert
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge;
and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are seeking highly qualified Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) across a wide range of academic, research, and industry disciplines to support the evaluation, testing, and improvement of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs).

In this role, you will leverage your expertise to evaluate AI-generated responses, design domain-specific prompts, identify knowledge gaps, and provide evidence-based feedback to improve the quality and reasoning capabilities of advanced AI systems.

Day - to - day task

  • Write domain-specific prompts of varying difficulty.
  • Compare multiple AI responses and rank them.
  • Explain why a response is correct or incorrect using authoritative references.
  • Identify ambiguous questions and propose improved prompts.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or higher in any field.
  • Minimum 3 years of professional, research, or teaching experience.
  • Excellent written English communication skills.
  • Strong analytical skills and exceptional attention to detail.


Preferred Qualifications

description:

title: Head Of Accounting
description:
About MAVI


MAVI places experienced finance and accounting professionals into senior, high-ownership roles at high-growth US companies.


We maintain a deliberately high bar on both sides of the placement. The companies we partner with are venture-backed and private equity-backed startups and SMEs building modern finance organizations, and the professionals we represent are operators with a track record of owning the numbers rather than supporting them from a distance.


The roles we place are embedded positions within the finance function itself. Our professionals work alongside founders, CEOs, and senior leadership on the work that determines whether a business can close its books with confidence and satisfy its auditors.


Our team has built and scaled finance functions at companies including Lyft, Ramp, and SoftBank. We remain closely involved throughout the relationship, from role alignment and interview preparation through onboarding, placement, and long-term career development.


The Role


We are seeking an experienced Head of Accounting to own the accounting function across a portfolio of high-growth US client companies, working remotely from Brazil.


This is the senior accounting seat for each company you serve, and it remains substantively hands-on. You will be accountable for the accuracy of the financial statements, the discipline of the close, the strength of the control environment, and the readiness of each client for its audit.


Where a client has outgrown the processes that carried it this far — a close held together by one person's memory, a revenue schedule maintained outside the ledger, a reconciliation that has not been cleared in three quarters — you will be the person who rebuilds them.


The portfolio structure is the defining feature of the role. You will hold several client companies at once, each at a different stage, on a different system, with a different close calendar. The work rewards someone who can carry that context without losing the detail, and who brings a consistent standard to every engagement rather than adapting to whatever each client has been doing.


You will work directly with founders, CEOs, and the leadership teams whose decisions depend on your numbers. A significant part of the role is translating accounting information into something people outside finance can act on, and doing so before they ask for it.


What You'll Own


The Close and Financial Reporting


  • The close. Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close for each client, with full accountability for the calendar, the quality of the output, and the cycle time.
  • The financial statements. Own the preparation of the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement under US GAAP, and stand behind those numbers in front of client leadership and auditors.
  • Revenue. Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the schedules, the deferred revenue roll-forward, and the judgements behind them.
  • Consolidation. Own multi-entity accounting, intercompany balances, eliminations, and foreign currency translation where a client's structure requires it.
  • Reporting packages. Prepare the monthly and quarterly reporting packages and variance analysis that founders, leadership, and investors rely on.


Controls, Policy, and Audit


  • Policies and controls. Establish and maintain accounting policies, internal controls, approval workflows, and reporting standards appropriate to each client's stage, and enforce them once established.
  • Documentation. Build and maintain the close checklist, process narratives, and standard operating procedures that allow each engagement to run without depending on any single individual.
  • Audit. Lead the annual audit or review end to end, including auditor management, PBC preparation, and resolution of findings through to close-out.
  • External partners. Manage external auditors, tax advisers, and outsourced bookkeeping partners, holding each to agreed standards and deadlines.

Accounting Operations

  • The transactional cycle. Own the general ledger, AP, AR, payroll accounting, and expense processing across the portfolio, holding each to defined turnaround and accuracy standards.
  • Reconciliations. Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and the resolution of ageing items, rather than the reporting of them.
  • Cash reporting. Prepare accurate cash reporting and the rolling cash forecast, and give leadership a reliable view of position and movement.


Team, Systems, and Standard


  • Client accounting teams. Review, mentor, and raise the standard of the accounting staff and bookkeepers working beneath you at each client.
  • Finance systems. Lead ERP selection, implementation, and migration across NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, and comparable platforms, alongside AP, expense, and close-management automation.
  • A consistent standard. Bring the same close discipline, documentation, and control expectations to every engagement, rather than inheriting each client's habits.


What We're Looking For


  • 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including direct leadership and development of accounting staff
  • Demonstrated ownership of the close and the financial statements on an independent basis, rather than contribution to someone else's
  • Strong command of US GAAP, with genuine depth in revenue recognition (ASC 606);
    leases (ASC 842) and stock-based compensation (ASC 718) are an advantage
  • Experience leading an audit or review, including direct management of external auditors through to resolution of findings
  • Experience with multi-entity accounting, consolidation, and intercompany elimination
  • A track record of designing accounting processes and controls from the ground up, or of taking on underperforming processes and rebuilding them
  • Demonstrated capacity to hold several companies or entities concurrently without loss of accuracy — prior experience in an outsourced accounting practice, a CPA firm, or a multi-entity group is directly relevant
  • Substantial ERP experience with NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Sage Intacct, or a comparable platform, alongside familiarity with modern finance tooling such as Ramp, Brex, Bill.Com, Rippling, or FloQast
  • Experience working remotely with US-based leadership, auditors, and CPA firms, with the communication discipline that arrangement requires
  • Excellent written and verbal English, with the confidence to hold the room in a leadership or audit setting
  • CRC-active Contador, CPA, ACCA, CIMA, or an equivalent professional qualification strongly preferred
  • Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience preferred
  • Experience serving venture-backed or PE-backed US companies, particularly from Seed through Series C, preferred
  • Direct experience carrying a first audit or an ERP implementation end to end is highly regarded
  • SaaS or recurring-revenue experience, including deferred revenue and the mechanics of ARR, is a significant advantage
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field


Who This Role Is For


This role is well suited to an accounting leader who wants to own the function outright, several times over, rather than administer one part of it once.


You are technically strong enough to reach a defensible conclusion without escalating it, and operationally strong enough to make sure the process behind it holds up next quarter and at the next client. You bring your own standard rather than adopting whatever you find. You are equally credible in a room with a founder, an auditor, and a junior bookkeeper.


Above all, you identify issues early, communicate them clearly to the people who need to know, and arrive with a practical recommendation rather than only a number.


Why Join Through MAVI


  • Own entire accounting functions, end to end, with direct exposure to US founders and senior leadership
  • Build the accounting infrastructure of growing companies rather than maintaining someone else's
  • Work to US GAAP with US auditors and US systems, on the standard that opens international opportunities
  • Gain breadth across several businesses, stages, and systems in a single seat
  • Progress toward Head of Finance and Fractional CFO opportunities through MAVI
  • Work remotely from Brazil in near-full overlap with the US business day


Work Arrangement


This is a fully remote role based in Brazil. You will serve several US client companies concurrently and will work directly with their founders, leadership teams, auditors, and external partners.

Core availability sits within the Brazilian business day and provides full coverage of US Eastern hours. There is no overnight requirement.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
MAVI partners with high-growth US startups and SMEs, embedding experienced accounting professionals directly within their finance teams. This is not a traditional accounting role — you will carry the close for US clients and own real areas of their books in a fast-moving environment.


The Opportunity


As a Senior Accountant, you will run the day-to-day accounting for US clients, reporting to the client's Controller or finance lead.


This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will see the close from first accrual to final statement and own the parts that are usually spread across three people, with a US finance lead reviewing your work and available when a call needs to be made above your level. It suits someone who wants to carry a full set of books rather than process a queue within them, and who fixes a broken process rather than working around it each month.


What You Will Own


  • Carry end-to-end accounting (Record-to-Report) for US clients on a defined close calendar
  • Own the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close cycles, with accountability for cycle time and the quality of what you deliver
  • Prepare journal entries, accruals, prepaids, fixed asset schedules, and month-end adjustments, with support attached
  • Prepare financial statements under US GAAP for Controller review, and answer for the numbers you produced
  • Own the balance sheet reconciliation process and drive ageing items to resolution rather than reporting them
  • Maintain the supporting schedules behind the balances — prepaid amortisation, accrual detail, fixed asset registers, deferred revenue rollforwards
  • Handle and review AP, AR, payroll accounting, and cash reporting for accuracy and correct coding
  • Prepare variance analysis with root-cause commentary, in terms someone outside finance can act on
  • Act as a day-to-day US client contact, building strong working relationships with their finance team
  • Prepare PBC deliverables and respond directly to auditor queries in your areas through to resolution
  • Operate within the client's accounting policies and controls, and flag where a control is followed in form but not in substance
  • Maintain the close checklists and SOPs that keep the close reproducible without depending on any single individual
  • Propose process improvements and automation that shorten the close


What We're Looking For


  • 5+ years of accounting experience with strong US GAAP exposure
  • Demonstrated ownership of a full close cycle end to end, rather than contribution to one part of it
  • Experience preparing full financial statements, including cash flow, for review
  • Strong reconciliation discipline and the judgment to know when a balance does not look right
  • Experience supporting an audit, including PBC preparation and direct auditor contact
  • ERP experience (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks, Toast, or similar)
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow
  • CA / CPA / ACCA (or equivalent), or active progress toward one, preferred
  • Excellent English communication, with the ability to explain an accounting outcome to a non-accountant
  • Ability to work with US time zone overlap


Why Join MAVI?


  • Carry a full close end to end for some of the most exciting US companies
  • Own real areas of a growing company's books rather than one corner of them
  • Gain exposure to audit, ERP work, and process design earlier than a comparable in-house role would offer
  • Clear progression to Accounting Team Lead, Accounting Manager, and Controller roles
  • Flexible remote work with global impact
  • Compensation in USD

Nossas soluções em compressores com tecnologia proprietária de vedação são usadas no processamento industrial de gases, tanto na indústria tradicional de petróleo e gás como na economia do hidrogênio verde. O portfólio de produtos também inclui sistemas de produção de hidrogênio sustentável, como eletrolisadores e reformadores a vapor, as principais tecnologias para a demanda futura por energia limpa. title: Senior Sell-Out Sales Manager
description:
Haier Smart Home has arrived in Brazil and is looking for a Senior Sell-out Sales Manager to join its team.


Work Modality: On-site work, in São Paulo - SP.


Responsabilities:

  • Undertake and complete regional terminal sell-out sales targets, track daily/weekly/monthly retail sales data, analyze sales gaps, formulate targeted terminal sales improvement plans and implement them efficiently;
  • Optimize channel inventory management, monitor the inventory turnover status of distributors and retail terminals in real time, reasonably adjust product delivery and sales rhythm, reduce overstock and out-of-stock risks, and improve inventory capital turnover efficiency;
  • Guide and assist offline retail stores, distributors and sales teams to carry out terminal sales promotion, product display optimization, sales skill training and customer service upgrading, and improve terminal retail conversion rate and customer repurchase rate;
  • Analyze terminal sales data including product sales structure, hot-selling/slow-moving SKUs, regional sales differences and consumer preference characteristics, put forward product matching and sales strategy optimization suggestions, and drive sales structure upgrading;
  • Organize and implement terminal localized promotion activities, seasonal marketing campaigns and retail incentive policies, stimulate the sales enthusiasm of terminal sales staff and distributors, and boost short-term sell-out increment;
  • Track the terminal sales performance of competing brands, summarize their terminal promotion methods, pricing strategies and retail operation models, formulate differentiated terminal sales countermeasures, and enhance Haier’s terminal market competitiveness;
  • Establish a standardized terminal sales management system, sort out sell-out business process specifications, regularly conduct terminal sales audits and effect evaluations, and form closed-loop management of terminal sales business;
  • Cooperate with the marketing, supply chain and channel management teams to ensure the matching of terminal product supply, promotional resources and sales policies, and fully guarantee the completion of sell-out targets.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Marketing, Business Management, Retail Operation or related majors;
  • Experience in terminal sell-out operation and sales management experience in Brazil’s home appliance/retail industry, familiar with local offline retail terminal operation logic and sales management modes;
  • Experience in terminal sales breakthrough, inventory optimization and retail team activation, with outstanding data analysis capability and practical problem-solving ability for terminal sales scenarios;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, proficient in local business communication and terminal team management, able to independently launch terminal sales promotion projects;
  • Sensitive to sales data, able to quickly locate terminal sales pain points, formulate executable improvement plans, and focus on result-oriented target delivery;
  • Strong execution, on-site management ability and pressure resistance, good at team motivation and cross-team business collaboration;
  • Familiar with the retail market rules and consumer characteristics of Brazil’s home appliance industry.

title: Engagement Director
description:
About HCLTech

HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


HCLTech is seeking a senior Engagement Director to lead a strategic insurance customer engagement in Brazil. The role carries end-to-end accountability for customer success, delivery excellence, operational governance, talent strategy, financial performance, transformation and long-term engagement growth.


About the Role:

The successful candidate will serve as the senior in-country HCLTech leader for the customer, combining executive relationship management with strong delivery rigor. The role requires someone who can lead a large, multidisciplinary services organization while shaping and governing capability build-up, managed services evolution and Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) commitments as part of the wider engagement lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities

Customer and Engagement Leadership

  • Serve as the primary customer-facing delivery executive and senior HCLTech representative for the engagement.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders;
    lead governance, service reviews and escalations.
  • Own customer satisfaction, stakeholder confidence and the overall health and strategic direction of the engagement.


Delivery and Operational Excellence

  • Own end-to-end delivery across application development, maintenance, support, quality engineering, service management and governance.
  • Ensure contractual, SLA, quality, risk and compliance commitments are met;
    drive stability, engineering excellence, automation and continuous improvement.
  • Build and lead the local delivery organization, including workforce planning, hiring, retention, succession and leadership development.


Organization and Talent Leadership

  • Build, scale and lead a high-performing local delivery organization in Brazil.
  • Own workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, retention, succession and leadership development.
  • Create a culture of accountability, collaboration, learning and customer centricity.


Financial and Commercial Accountability

  • Own revenue, margin, forecasting, productivity and delivery economics.
  • Drive operational efficiency and partner with account leadership on qualified growth opportunities.
  • Balance customer outcomes with commercial and contractual discipline.


Transformation and BOT Operating Model

  • Shape and govern capability build-up, service transition and operating model evolution alongside steady-state delivery.
  • Understand BOT design considerations including organization structure, talent ownership, knowledge transfer, process maturity, controls, tooling, service acceptance and transfer readiness.
  • Ensure BOT milestones are integrated into the overall engagement plan and do not become a disconnected transition workstream.
  • Drive the evolution from capacity-led delivery toward mature, outcome-oriented managed services where relevant.
  • Maintain service continuity and customer confidence through build, operate, stabilization and transfer phases.
  • Ensure that knowledge, documentation, processes, governance and leadership capability are designed for sustainable transfer, not assembled only at the end.


Strategic Growth and Partnership Value

  • Identify opportunities to deepen the customer relationship and expand HCLTech relevance.
  • Bring new ideas across engineering, automation, AI-enabled delivery, service modernization and operating model improvement.
  • Translate customer priorities into an actionable engagement roadmap with measurable business and service outcomes.
  • Position the engagement as a strategic partnership rather than a resource-supply arrangement.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience in IT services, consulting, managed services or enterprise technology delivery.
  • Senior customer-facing delivery or engagement leadership roles.
  • Proven experience leading a large strategic customer engagement and multidisciplinary delivery organization.
  • Strong executive stakeholder management, governance and escalation leadership.
  • P&L or substantial revenue, margin, forecasting and productivity accountability.
  • Experience driving transformation or operating model change while maintaining business-as-usual delivery.
  • Practical exposure to at least one of the following: BOT, GCC/captive setup, major service transition, vendor consolidation, managed services transformation or creation of a local delivery organization.


Habilidades Necessárias

  • Brazil or Latin America delivery leadership experience.
  • Portuguese proficiency with strong English communication skills.
  • Experience in application services, quality engineering and IT service management within a global, multi-vendor environment.
  • Experience working across global teams, cultures, time zones and multi-vendor ecosystems.


Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws.

title: Creative Designer
description:

A pessoa trabalhará em colaboração constante com as equipes de conteúdo, marketing e desenvolvimento, acompanhando feedbacks e realizando os ajustes necessários para garantir qualidade, coerência e cumprimento dos prazos.

A vaga é remota, em regime de tempo integral, com comunicação e acompanhamento das atividades por meio de ferramentas de colaboração online.


Principais responsabilidades


  • Criar peças para redes sociais, campanhas digitais, sites, landing pages, apresentações e materiais institucionais;
  • Desenvolver layouts estáticos, animados e desdobramentos para diferentes formatos e canais;
  • Pesquisar tendências, referências visuais, concorrentes e características do público de cada projeto;
  • Criar conceitosvisuais que comuniquem as mensagens de forma clara, estratégica e atraente;
  • Aplicar e preservar a identidade visual das marcas atendidas;
  • Participar de brainstorms e contribuir com ideias e soluções criativas;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de inteligência artificial como apoio à pesquisa, ideação, criação e otimização do trabalho;
  • Organizar arquivos e materiais de maneira padronizada;
  • Receber feedbacks, realizar ajustes e acompanhar as demandas até a aprovação final;
  • Gerenciar diferentes projetos simultaneamente, mantendo organização, qualidade e cumprimento dos prazos.


Qualificações


  • Experiência comprovada na criação de peças digitais e impressas;
  • Domínio das principais ferramentas da Adobe Creative Cloud, especialmente Photoshop e Illustrator;
  • Conhecimento prático de ferramentas de inteligência artificial aplicadas ao design;
  • Criatividade, senso estético e capacidade de transformar briefings em soluções visuais relevantes;
  • Perfil proativo, organizado, colaborativo e comprometido com prazos;
  • Interesse e iniciativa para pesquisar referências, tendências e novas possibilidades criativas;
  • Conhecimentos de identidade visual, branding e aplicação de guias de marca;
  • Boa compreensãode tipografia, hierarquia visual, legibilidade, composição, cores e tratamento de imagens;
  • Capacidade de interpretar feedbacks e realizar ajustes com atenção aos detalhes;
  • Portfólio atualizado com trabalhos relevantes.


Diferenciais


  • Formação em Design, Comunicação Visual, Publicidade ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência anterior em agência de marketing ou ambiente com múltiplos projetos e clientes;
  • Conhecimentos de Figma e princípios de UI Design;
  • Experiência commotion design, edição de vídeos ou ferramentas como After Effects e Premiere;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de IA para geração e edição de imagens, pesquisa de referências e desenvolvimento de conceitos visuais.

title: Ombudsman / Ouvidor
description:
About VelaFi

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.

Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.


Position Overview

VelaFi Brazil is looking for a qualified Ombudsman (Ouvidor) to manage the mandatory Ouvidoria structure for our regulated VASP entity under Resolution BCB No. 552/2025, Resolution BCB No. 28/2021, and CMN Resolution No. 4,860/2020.

Serving as the second-instance escalation mechanism, the Ombudsman acts independently from operational and sales teams, championing client rights and reporting systemic insights directly to top management.


Location

Hybrid: Sao Paulo, Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Second-Instance Complaints: Receive, register, and resolve complex client complaints escalated from standard customer service (SAC) within mandatory BCB resolution timeframes.
  • Independent Mediation: Act as an impartial mediator between clients and internal operational units.
  • Root-Cause Analysis: Identify recurring operational failures or systemic compliance risks and recommend corrective action plans to executive leadership.
  • BCB & Board Reporting: Prepare periodic Ombudsman reports (Relatório de Ouvidoria ) detailing complaint volume, resolution metrics, and root cause analyses for internal governance and BCB regulatory filings.

Qualifications

title: Assistente Executivo De Diretoria Jurídica
description:
Estamos com uma posição aberta para apoiar as diretorias jurídicas de nossos clientes.

É uma vaga para quem gosta de trabalhar perto de decisões, transita bem entre lideranças diferentes e entende que boa parte do resultado vem de resolver o que ainda não foi pedido.


ROTINA DO PROFISSIONAL


Agendas : Organizar, priorizar a agenda das diretorias jurídicas. Olhar a semana adiante, enxergar os conflitos antes que eles aconteçam e resolver a logística de cada compromisso antes que ela vire problema (sala, equipamento, deslocamento, participantes, material de apoio, tempo de intervalo entre um compromisso e outro).


Apresentações e materiais visuais: Montar o material das diretorias, do zero ou a partir do conteúdo enviado pelos gerentes e coordenadores jurídicos.

Não se trata de formatar o que chega, mas sim propor layout, caminhos para deixar a informação mais clara e melhorias de visualização (o gráfico que substitui uma tabela densa, o diagrama que resolve um parágrafo confuso, o corte que tira do slide o que não precisava estar ali). O material também não sai sempre no mesmo formato. Dependendo de onde vai ser usado, pode virar apresentação para reunião, peça para tela, PDF, conteúdo para comunicação interna ou material de apoio para uma sessão remota, e a escolha do meio faz parte do trabalho.

Uma parte importante disso é garantir que a informação chegue: fazer follow up de pessoas sêniores, em mais de uma frente ao mesmo tempo, com educação e firmeza, faz parte do dia a dia.


Rotinas administrativas: Viagens, reembolsos, controles internos, interface com outras áreas e fornecedores, e o que mais sustentar o funcionamento das diretorias.


Profissional que buscamos:

A palavra "proativo" aparece em toda vaga, então vale dizer o que ela significa aqui: perceber que a reunião de quinta vai precisar de um material que ainda não existe e começar a providenciar antes de alguém lembrar.

O profissional deve antecipar a necessidade e realizar a demanda não esperar o comando.

Atender mais de uma liderança também exige uma competência específica: decidir o que vem primeiro quando duas demandas urgentes chegam juntas, resolver o que é possível resolver sozinho e escalar apenas o que precisa de decisão. Se tudo virar pergunta, a posição não funciona.


Conhecimentos:

  • Comunicação escrita e oral muito boa em português. Você vai falar com diretoria, gerência e áreas externas, e o texto precisa sair pronto.
  • Domínio do idioma inglês para apresentações, tratativas com contatos fora do Brasil e reuniões
  • Domínio real de PowerPoint, Canva e outras plataformas para elaboração de apresentações. Não estamos falando de "nível intermediário": você vai produzir apresentações que chegam à diretoria e à presidência, então esperamos noção de hierarquia da informação, gráfico legível, consistência visual e repertório de layout para propor caminhos, não só executar. Há teste prático no processo.
  • Excel para os controles do dia a dia e para transformar dados em gráfico apresentável.
  • Discrição. A área jurídica lida com informação sensível, e isso não é negociável.
  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento. Administração, secretariado, comunicação, gestão ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência anterior em apoio a executivos jurídicos ou em rotina administrativa de área com volume alto de reuniões e prazos.


Conta como diferencial

  • Espanhol para leitura e conversação.
  • Vivência em departamento jurídico interno, escritório de advocacia ou compliance.
  • Edição simples de imagem e vídeo, visualização de dados.
  • Uso de ferramentas de IA no dia a dia administrativo, com critério — sabendo revisar e checar o que a ferramenta entrega.
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de gestão de despesas e reembolso.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Você fará parte da área de Inteligência de Dados e IA (IDeIA), responsável pelas plataformas de dados utilizadas pelos times de produto da TOTVS.


Todos os dias, terabytes de dados de ERP passam por essas plataformas e sustentam projetos de dezenas de times internos. Do agronegócio ao varejo, da construção à saúde, esses dados apoiam a operação e a tomada de decisão de milhares de empresas brasileiras.


Nesta posição, você atuará em parceria com os times que desenvolvem nossos produtos, ajudando a transformar necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados seguras, eficientes e escaláveis. Suas responsabilidades incluirão o desenho técnico das soluções, a revisão de arquiteturas, o apoio na resolução de questões técnicas e a identificação de oportunidades de evolução das plataformas.


A atuação é principalmente consultiva. Os times de produtos internos conduzem a implementação, enquanto você orienta as decisões arquiteturais, compartilha boas práticas e contribui para ampliar o uso de dados e IA nas soluções TOTVS.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Conduzir o onboarding de novos times nas plataformas de dados;
  • Elaborar desenhos técnicos em conjunto com os times e revisar a arquitetura dos projetos;
  • Orientar engenheiros na resolução de dúvidas por chat, chamados e videochamadas;
  • Acompanhar soluções, considerando custo, desempenho, confiabilidade e experiência de uso;
  • Criar automações e agentes de apoio que ampliem a autonomia dos usuários das plataformas;
  • Disseminar boaspráticas de arquitetura, engenharia de dados e uso responsável de IA;
  • Propor evoluções e melhorias para as plataformas com base nos aprendizados da operação;
  • Construir e sustentar pipelines de dados batch e streaming em produção;
  • Atuar com orquestração de cargas, tratamento de falhas, monitoramento e rastreabilidade;
  • Integrar dados por meio de APIs e sistemas de mensageria, considerando a consistência dos dados;
  • Definir estratégias de cargas completas e incrementais;
  • Apoiar a definição da camada de consumo considerando volume, latência e custo;
  • Disponibilizar dados por APIs REST, MCP ou ferramentas de BI;
  • Atuar na gestãoe otimização de custos em nuvem, incluindo análise de billing e utilização de recursos;
  • Apoiar a aplicação de boas práticas de segurança, autenticação, autorização e controle de acesso;
  • Atuar com segurança e isolamento de dados entre clientes em ambientes multi-tenant;


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência com serviços de nuvem para ingestão, processamento e consumo de dados;
  • Experiência commodelagem dimensional e arquiteturas de dados em camadas;
  • Conhecimento dedata warehouses, bancos de dados de baixa latência e mecanismos de cache;
  • Experiência compipelines batch e streaming em produção;
  • Conhecimento deAPIs REST, sistemas de mensageria e integração de dados;
  • Conhecimento deautenticação, autorização e controle de acesso;
  • Capacidade paraanalisar diferentes cenários e orientar decisões arquiteturais;
  • Capacidade paradiscutir arquitetura com engenheiros e sustentar recomendações técnicas;
  • Comunicação escrita clara, estruturada e adequada a diferentes públicos;
  • Autonomia para investigar problemas e propor soluções;
  • Pensamento crítico para identificar oportunidades de automação e aprimorar a experiência de uso;
  • Inglês para leitura e compreensão de documentação técnica;
  • Conhecimentos em GCP, especialmente BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, Pub/Sub e Dataflow;
  • Conhecimentos em SQL, Python e JavaScript (Node.Js);
  • Conhecimentos em APIs REST, MCP e DuckDB;
  • Conhecimentos em Looker Studio ou ferramentas de BI e visualização;
  • Conhecimentos em Jenkins e GitHub Actions;
  • Conhecimentos em Terraform e Git;
  • Conhecimentos em Jira e Zendesk;
  • Conhecimentos ou experiência com Gemini e OpenAI (Codex).


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Atuação em plataformas de dados que atendam times internos;
  • Conhecimento desistemas ERP, especialmente Protheus, RM, Datasul ou Winthor;
  • Experiência comotimização de consultas por meio de particionamento, clusterização e controle de custos;
  • Experiência comLooker Studio ou outras ferramentas de BI e visualização;

title: Business Development Manager & Legal Representative – Medical Devices
description:
About Taevas

Taevas Life Sciences is a medical technology company delivering advanced diagnostic devices across areas such as audiology, balance & vestibular care, sleep therapy, and imaging.
